name.en: Texas State Highway 70 — Sweetwater to the Panhandle
name.zh: 得克萨斯 70 号州道（自斯威特沃特通往狭长地带）

tagline.en: Straight north through the Rolling Plains to the Oklahoma line
tagline.zh: 沿起伏平原一路正北，直抵俄克拉何马州界

mileageSource: TxDOT Highway Designation File, State Highway No. 70, certified mileage open to traffic, 2010

start.en: US 277 south of Blackwell, in Coke County
start.zh: 科克县布莱克韦尔以南的 US 277

end.en: SH 15 at Perryton, near the Oklahoma line
end.zh: 俄克拉何马州界附近佩里顿的 SH 15

en: SH 70 is a north–south line drawn across the least-travelled part of Texas. It runs 315.944 miles from US 277 in Coke County up through Sweetwater, Roby, Rotan, Jayton, Spur, Dickens, Roaring Springs, Matador, Turkey, Clarendon and Pampa to Perryton at the top of the Panhandle, crossing twelve counties on the way.

For most of that distance it is a two-lane road through ranch and cotton country, joining county seats to each other. Its intersections say more about it than its towns do: it is concurrent with US 380 to Jayton, with SH 86 through Turkey, with SH 256 briefly in Briscoe County, with US 287 through Clarendon, and with Interstate 40 for about three and a half miles near the Donley–Gray county line.

The interesting middle is where the road runs below the Caprock Escarpment. Between Matador and Turkey it crosses the Little Red River valley, and the ground around it is red canyon country rather than plain; north of Turkey the land drops away into the canyons that Caprock Canyons State Park protects.
zh: SH 70 是横过得州人迹最少地带的一条南北向直线。它自科克县的 US 277 起，全长 315.944 英里，北上经斯威特沃特、罗比、罗坦、杰顿、斯珀、迪肯斯、罗灵斯普林斯、马塔多、特基、克拉伦登与潘帕，直至狭长地带顶端的佩里顿，沿途跨越十二个县。
这段距离的大部分是穿行于牧场与棉田之间的双车道公路，把各县县城串在一起。它的交叉口比它的城镇更能说明它的性质：与 US 380 共线至杰顿，与 SH 86 共线穿过特基，在布里斯科县与 SH 256 短暂共线，与 US 287 共线穿过克拉伦登，并在唐利—格雷县界附近与 40 号州际公路共线约三英里半。
有意思的中段是道路行经卡普罗克断崖之下的部分。在马塔多与特基之间，它横穿小红河谷，周围的地貌是红色峡谷地带而非平原；特基以北，地势陷落成卡普罗克峡谷州立公园所保护的那片峡谷。

en: TxDOT's designation file shows this route assembled northward in stages. In the general redescription of the highway system in September 1939, SH 70 ran from US 67 east of San Angelo, through Tennyson, Bronte, Sweetwater and Rotan, and finished at Dickens.

The Panhandle half arrived in October 1947, when the route was carried on from Dickens via Matador, Turkey, Clarendon and Jericho to US 66 and then north through Pampa to Perryton. The order recording it notes two things at once: the section from Dickens to Matador was added, and the whole of SH 18 was assigned to SH 70.

The southern end was then trimmed twice — first when the San Angelo to Bronte stretch was transferred to US 277 in February 1948, then corrected that July to start about nine miles north of Bronte. By a redescription in August 1990 the route was measured at roughly 342 miles; the certified mileage open to traffic today is shorter than that.
zh: 得州交通部的路线划定档案显示，这条路线是分阶段向北拼接而成的。在 1939 年 9 月公路系统的整体重新描述中，SH 70 自圣安吉洛以东的 US 67 起，经坦尼森、布朗特、斯威特沃特和罗坦，止于迪肯斯。
狭长地带那一半在 1947 年 10 月加入：路线自迪肯斯继续经马塔多、特基、克拉伦登和杰里科至 US 66，再向北经潘帕至佩里顿。记载此事的命令同时提到两件事：新增了迪肯斯至马塔多路段，并将整条 SH 18 并入 SH 70。
南端此后两次缩短——先是 1948 年 2 月把圣安吉洛至布朗特一段划归 US 277，同年 7 月又更正为自布朗特以北约九英里起算。按 1990 年 8 月的一次重新描述，全线约为 342 英里；今天已通车的认证里程比这个数字要短。

en: This is a road for people who like being alone on one. In Roberts County, between Pampa and Perryton, its only intersections are with a handful of farm-to-market roads leading to the county seat at Miami. There is no mountain pass, no seasonal closure and no toll anywhere on it.

The towns are the reason to stop, and several of them are much smaller than they were. Roaring Springs, eight miles south of Matador, had 514 residents and thirty-five businesses in 1940; it was platted in 1912 in anticipation of a railway, and passenger rail service ended in 1971.

Turkey, where SH 70 briefly shares pavement with SH 86, is Bob Wills's home town and is organised around saying so. A few miles north, the road passes into the Little Red River valley — the stretch state photographers keep coming back to, where red canyon walls sit under an otherwise flat horizon.
zh: 这是一条适合喜欢独自行路的人的公路。在潘帕与佩里顿之间的罗伯茨县，它唯一的交叉口是几条通往县城迈阿密的农市道路。全线没有越岭段、没有季节性封闭，也没有任何收费。
沿途的城镇才是停车的理由，而其中好几个都比从前小了许多。马塔多以南八英里的罗灵斯普林斯在 1940 年有 514 名居民和三十五家商铺；它于 1912 年因预期铁路修建而划定镇址，客运铁路服务于 1971 年终止。
SH 70 与 SH 86 短暂共用路面的特基，是鲍勃·威尔斯的故乡，整座镇子都围绕着这件事来组织。再往北几英里，道路进入小红河谷——这是本州摄影者反复回访的一段，在原本平坦的天际线之下，立着红色的峡谷岩壁。

figures.source: TxDOT Highway Designation File, State Highway No. 70, certified mileage 2010

value.en: Twelve: Ochiltree, Roberts, Gray, Donley, Hall, Briscoe, Motley, Dickens, Kent, Fisher, Nolan and Coke
value.zh: 十二个：奥奇尔特里、罗伯茨、格雷、唐利、霍尔、布里斯科、莫特利、迪肯斯、肯特、菲舍尔、诺兰与科克

figures.source: TxDOT Highway Designation File, State Highway No. 70, Minute Order 090669, 29 August 1990

value.zh: 约 342 英里，此后经历调整

figures.source: TxDOT Highway Designation File, State Highway No. 70, Minute Order 090669, 29 August 1990

why.en: No total exists. The route was built up over half a century by adding sections and absorbing another numbered highway, and TxDOT keeps cost records by project rather than by highway number.
why.zh: 并无总数。本路线在半个世纪中通过增段并并入另一条编号公路而成，得州交通部按项目而非按公路编号保存造价记录。

why.en: No route-level count could be verified from TxDOT this session. Volumes would in any case be dominated by the short urban stretches at Sweetwater and Pampa and say nothing about the Roberts County section.
why.zh: 本次查证未能从得州交通部取得全线交通量数据。况且数值会被斯威特沃特与潘帕的短途城市路段主导，完全无法说明罗伯茨县路段的情况。

why.en: TxDOT publishes no surface or closure summary per highway number. The route is paved and has no scheduled closures, but no citable agency statement covering the whole route was located.
why.zh: 得州交通部未按公路编号发布路面或封闭情况汇总。本路线为铺装路面且无计划性封闭，但未能找到覆盖全线的可引用官方表述。

timeline.en: In the general redescription of the Texas highway system, SH 70 runs from east of San Angelo only as far as Dickens.
timeline.zh: 在得州公路系统整体重新描述中，SH 70 自圣安吉洛以东仅通至迪肯斯。

timeline.en: The route is extended through Matador, Turkey and Clarendon to Perryton, absorbing the whole of SH 18.
timeline.zh: 路线经马塔多、特基、克拉伦登延伸至佩里顿，并并入整条 SH 18。

timeline.en: The southern end is transferred to US 277 and the terminus moved to about nine miles north of Bronte.
timeline.zh: 南端划归 US 277，终点移至布朗特以北约九英里处。

timeline.en: TxDOT redescribes the route, then measured at roughly 342 miles.
timeline.zh: 得州交通部重新描述该路线，当时里程约为 342 英里。
